text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccines work by teaching your body how to recognize and fight the virus that causes COVID-19. They do this by introducing a weakened or inactive form of the virus, or a piece of its genetic code, into your body.

This allows your immune system to develop antibodies against the virus, without you getting sick. If you are later exposed to the live virus, your body will be better equipped to fight it off, reducing your risk of severe illness, hospitalization, and death.
